data.name: Chitrarth
data.gender_notes: Chitrarth is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chitrarth is a Hindu name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Picture of Essence' or 'Depiction of Reality'. The name Chitrarth carries the meaning “Picture of Essence” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chitrarth usually hope their child will grow to embody picture of essence and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chitrarth total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
